# Zoya — live agent traces
Every voice command is one trace (`zoya.command`) with Strands agent, model and tool spans and one span per AWS call. Open **CloudWatch → Application Signals → Transaction Search** and click a trace ID for the full X-Ray trace.

properties.query: SOURCE 'aws/spans' | filter name = "zoya.command" | stats avg(`attributes.zoya.total_ms`) as avg_ms, pct(`attributes.zoya.total_ms`, 90) as p90_ms, count(*) as tasks by bin(1m)
properties.title: Task latency (ms) — voice command to done

properties.query: SOURCE 'aws/spans' | filter name = "zoya.command" | fields @timestamp, `attributes.zoya.route` as route, `attributes.zoya.tool` as fast_tool, `attributes.zoya.total_ms` as total_ms, traceId | sort @timestamp desc | limit 20
properties.title: Recent tasks

properties.query: SOURCE 'aws/spans' | filter name like /^execute_tool / | stats count(*) as calls, avg(durationNano) / 1000000 as avg_ms by `attributes.gen_ai.tool.name` as tool | sort calls desc | limit 25
properties.title: Tool calls

properties.query: SOURCE 'aws/spans' | filter `attributes.rpc.system` = "aws-api" | stats count(*) as calls, avg(durationNano) / 1000000 as avg_ms by traceId, `attributes.rpc.service` as service | sort traceId desc | limit 50
properties.title: AWS services per task

properties.query: SOURCE 'aws/spans' | filter name = "chat" | stats count(*) as calls, sum(`attributes.gen_ai.usage.input_tokens`) as input_tokens, sum(`attributes.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens`) as output_tokens by `attributes.gen_ai.request.model` as model
properties.title: Model calls and tokens

properties.query: SOURCE 'aws/spans' | filter `status.code` = "ERROR" | stats count(*) as errors by name | sort errors desc
properties.title: Errors
